question: What battery-life problems or benefits do iPhone 8 owners report?
answer:
One reviewer said the iPhone 8 has good battery life. [ce0478a9dbf2_0]
Another reviewer reported low battery life on the iPhone 8, saying it was less than their older iPhone 7+. [9b07710b7035_0]
One reviewer stated the iPhone 8's battery life was not long enough. [a3758ec9bcd8_0]
A reviewer of a refurbished iPhone 8 reported battery health at 84% and said it lasts through the day. [f5886ed25a67_2]
One reviewer called the iPhone 8's battery life horrible and a waste of money. [adfa7cfff851_0]
Other reviewers reported battery health figures of 76%, 72%, and 71% on their iPhone 8 units. [a7daeebba88d_0] [9d8245d46e8c_0] [decb85d9f811_0]

It did not come with headphones, so if you are buying an iPhone 8, you'll have to buy Bluetooth headphones or Earpods with the lightning connector, which are about $29 on the Apple site. Battery health is 72%. I bought an iphone 8. And the health of the battery is 72%

Good iPhone 8. I got the iPhone 8 in and it looked new and it’s functions are excellent. Battery seems pretty good though I am on the internet a lot so that always drains a battery down. If I leave the phone idle. The battery will last longer. That’s a no brainer! So I have no complaints

Renewed Unlocked iPhone 8: Battery Degraded--71%. Bought this iPhone 8 in supposed excellent condition. Battery life is supposed to be over 80% but Battery Health setting says "Your battery's health is significantly degraded." and "Maximum Capacity 71%" The phone also got quite hot when I plugged it in. I don't think this qualifies as "Fully Functional, Excellent Condition, Battery Life at least 80%" The phone looks nice. I received it 2 days ago and am trying to figure out what to do. My iPhone 6 still has 100% battery life on a 3yo battery, and works fine but won't run up to date software for the app I need. Needless to say this is frustrating and time consuming. "Product Support" on my Amazon order sent me to Apple. But this is not their problem. If I undo everything, return it, and try for another, i am taking the same risk or even other risks.
Love the iPhone 8 recommended. It is a good phone it works perfectly. It’s better then iPhone 6 that I had. Battery life is longer.
